description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
summary: Archify is an agent skill that takes a plain-English description of a system and emits a single self-contained HTML file with interactive architecture, sequence, or data-flow diagrams—no server, no build step, just open the file. That slots directly into how I drive sessions through PenguPool and AgentOn Pocket: I prompt a Codex or Claude session to diagram a request path or a lifecycle, get a portable artifact I can drop into a README or hand to a teammate, and the source-backed links in the output make it verifiable rather than decorative. I like that the result is one HTML file you can diff, version, and share without anyone installing a diagramming tool.
